module.purpose: Provides the asset-association planning logic used by the sync worker to identify uploads that require URL migration or object copying into user-content storage.
module.summary: This module analyzes arbitrary records, filters them to valid asset records, derives their uploads-bucket object names, and produces two change plans. Assets already associated with the target slug can receive a URL-only migration, while assets associated elsewhere can be copied to newly generated object names unless their missing objects were previously recorded. Invalid, unsupported, or bookmark assets are ignored.
module.businessContext: Supports migration and synchronization of user-uploaded assets between storage URL formats and ownership namespaces. Incorrect planning can leave assets inaccessible, duplicate objects, or repeatedly retry missing uploads.
classes: AssetToReplace (~L4-9): Describes an asset requiring object copying and URL replacement
AssetToMigrate (~L11-14): Describes an asset requiring only a source URL migration
functions: getUploadObjectName (~L21-31): Extracts and validates an uploads-bucket object name
collectAssetAssociationChanges (~L39-82): Builds replacement and migration plans from asset records
systemCapabilities: Avoid retries for known missing objects

given: const records = [{ typeName: 'asset', id: 'asset-1', type: 'image', meta: { fileId: 'doc-slug' }, props: { src: 'https://old.example/object-1' } }]
moduleContractTests.rationale: URL migration rewrites the source without scheduling an object copy.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A non-current asset references an object previously found missing from the uploads bucket.
given: const records = [{ typeName: 'asset', id: 'asset-1', type: 'image', meta: { fileId: 'other-slug' }, props: { src: 'https://old.example/object-1' } }]
moduleContractTests.rationale: Previously missing objects must not trigger repeated copy attempts.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A valid asset belongs to another slug and is not skipped.
given: const records = [{ typeName: 'asset', id: 'asset-1', type: 'image', meta: { fileId: 'other-slug' }, props: { src: 'https://old.example/object-1-png' } }]
moduleContractTests.then: expect(...).toMatchObject({ assetsToMigrate: [], assetsToReplace: [{ objectName: 'object-1-png', assetId: 'asset-1', newSrc: expect.stringMatching(/^https:\/\/content\.example\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+-png$/) }] })
moduleContractTests.rationale: Foreign assets receive a newly generated object name while preserving the file-type suffix.

detail.name: getUploadObjectName
detail.signature: export function getUploadObjectName(asset: { type?: string; props?: { src?: string | null } }): string | null

parameters.name: asset
parameters.type: { type?: string; props?: { src?: string | null } }

preconditions: The asset argument is an object compatible with the declared asset shape.
postconditions: Returns null when props.src is absent, null, empty, or does not start with 'http'.
For an eligible source, returns the final slash-delimited segment only when it is a valid R2 object name; otherwise returns null.
invariants: Source-prefix matching is case-sensitive and requires the source to start with 'http'.
The candidate object name is obtained from the final segment of src split on '/'.
The function does not mutate the input asset.
edgeCases: A bookmark asset returns null without using its source.
An asset without props or with a null, empty, or otherwise falsy src returns null.
A source not beginning with 'http' returns null.
A source ending in '/' produces no usable object name and returns null.
A source whose final segment fails R2 object-name validation returns null.
A source with a valid final segment returns that segment, excluding preceding slash-delimited components.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Returns null for unsupported asset types, missing or non-HTTP sources, missing final path segments, and invalid R2 object names.

detail.summary: Derives an upload object name from an asset source URL when the asset is eligible and the extracted name is a valid R2 object name. Returns null for bookmarks, missing or non-HTTP sources, missing path segments, and invalid object names.

specLiterals.role: Asset type that is excluded from upload object-name derivation.
Case-sensitive prefix required for a source to be considered.
Delimiter used to split the source and select its final path segment.

specTests.then: The result is null because the source does not start with 'http'.
The result is null because no source is present.

units.name: collectAssetAssociationChanges

detail.name: collectAssetAssociationChanges
preconditions: Each processed asset record provides the properties required by getUploadObjectName, including id, meta, and props.src.
postconditions: Returns an object with assetsToReplace and assetsToMigrate arrays.
Only records whose typeName is exactly asset and for which getUploadObjectName returns a truthy object name can contribute to either output.
Assets already associated with slug and whose source starts with userContentUrl are excluded from both outputs.
Replacement entries receive a generated object name and a new source URL rooted at userContentUrl.
Migration entries preserve the asset id and use the existing object name under userContentUrl.
invariants: Input records are processed in iteration order, and each output preserves the relative order of records contributing to that output.
A record is added to at most one output array.
The returned arrays are newly created for each invocation.
edgeCases: An empty records iterable returns empty assetsToReplace and assetsToMigrate arrays.
Records whose typeName is not exactly asset are ignored.
Asset records for which getUploadObjectName returns a falsy value are ignored.
An asset with meta.fileId equal to slug and a source not starting with userContentUrl is added to assetsToMigrate and not assetsToReplace.
An asset with meta.fileId equal to slug and a source starting with userContentUrl is ignored.
An asset with a nonmatching meta.fileId is skipped when skipObjectNames contains its object name.
An asset with a nonmatching meta.fileId and an object name not in skipObjectNames is added to assetsToReplace; its replacement name preserves the suffix after the final hyphen when one exists.
If a processed asset lacks a usable source value supporting startsWith, evaluation may throw rather than returning a result.

raises: Propagates exceptions thrown while iterating records, resolving upload object names, generating unique ids, or evaluating required asset properties.
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or recovery is performed; malformed processed asset records can cause a runtime exception.

stateMutations: Mutates only invocation-local assetsToReplace and assetsToMigrate arrays; no caller-visible input, global, or persistent state is intentionally mutated.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns { assetsToReplace: AssetToReplace[]; assetsToMigrate: AssetToMigrate[] }. Migration entries have assetId and newSrc set to `${userContentUrl}/${objectName}`. Replacement entries have objectName, newObjectName, assetId, and newSrc set to `${userContentUrl}/${newObjectName}`.
detail.summary: Classifies asset records into assets requiring source migration and assets requiring replacement with newly generated object names. Non-asset, unresolvable, already-associated, and explicitly skipped records are excluded from replacement output.

specLiterals.role: Exact record typeName required for asset processing.
Constructs the new source URL for migrated assets.
Constructs the new source URL for replacement assets.
Separates generated object ids from an existing file-type suffix in object names.
